identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: Black & White

leadText:
In , Ash Ketchum travels to the distant Unova region with his partner to continue his quest to become a Pokémon Master. In this new land, he meets new in , an aspiring Dragon Master, and , a Pokémon Connoisseur and Gym Leader. Together, they travel through the region as Ash aims to collect eight Gym Badges to compete in the Unova League and Iris keeps working towards her goal of becoming a Dragon Master. Along the way, they face challenges from rivals like Trip and threats posed by the evil machinations of the villainous organizations Team Rocket and Team Plasma.

Following their adventures in Unova, the group departs from the region and sets out to sail through the Decolore Islands on their way to the Kanto region.
